description: Instructional illustration of one finite glass pane, one thick board/platform and one upright rod with a small base/contact region. Visible glass edges and material appearance support the approved abstraction from a body with length, width and thickness to a surface when thickness is ignored. Scratch candidate binds the actual single authorized opaque generation without background removal; no scale, measured 3D angle, label or independent acceptance claim is present.

authoritativeText.text:
人们在实际活动中遇到的体具有有限的尺寸。
一块窗户玻璃是具有长、宽和厚的体。
如果忽略它的厚度，我们可以认为它是几何的面的模型（图 72）。

一段铁丝当然是体，但是它的横截面比起它的长度来说是很小的。
忽略铁丝横截面的大小，我们就可以得到几何的线的形象（图 73）。
如果想象一个物体的尺寸很小，而且决定完全忽略它的大小，我们就可以得到几何的点的概念。

但是，所有这些都是个别的、在实践中找到的方法，有时是准确的，有时仅仅是近似的。
埃及人和巴比伦人也可能没有探究这种区别。
既没有准确的定义，也没有清楚的证明。

2. 几何作为一门系统的、借助严格的逻辑推理发展的科学，是公元前四至三世纪时在古代希腊产生的。
希腊数学家借助什么来建立几何科学的严整体系呢？
为了做到这点，他们必须认识到：在定义和研究几何图形时，需要舍弃我们周围物体具有的某些性质。

他们决定研究完全没有大小的点的性质、完全没有宽度的线的性质，等等。
没有大小的“几何点”或者没有宽度的直线，既看不见又“摸”不着，但是这并没有难住希腊数学家。
关于这一点，我们稍微详细地说一说。

inventory.description: Frozen source: one obliquely viewed pane with a four-sided projected outline. Generated semantic content, not deterministic measured geometry; acceptance requires seeing the whole pane.
Long sloping upper edge, locally doubled to show a finite edge; keep the high corner and the rod crossing distinct.
Descending left edge with close thickness contours; it overlaps the board region and continues below the board.
Full long right outline from the high corner to the right/lower corner, not cropped at the board.

Full lower sloping outline and foreground tip below the board; source contains doubled or broken sections. A clean modern material edge is an explicitly declared visual regularization, not a new measurement.

Source reflection strokes across upper/left, lower-left and multiple right-side regions distinguish clear glass. Modern highlights may replace old hatching but must not become a grid, rays or a scale.
One broad obliquely viewed board/platform top; it extends left of the nearby pane overlap and remains visible through the pane projection.
Finite slab with a thick front/side rim, especially at the left and foreground edge; not a zero-thickness floating surface.
Board/wood-grain-like top-face strokes in source. Natural neutral board material is a modern appearance choice, not a source-certified species or measured structure.
Exactly one dark upright rod/post, passing through the projected upper-edge region and extending above that crossing, but remaining lower than the highest pane corner.
Retain a small foot/contact at the rod's lower end on the board; do not invent detailed clamps, screws, extra supports or penetration measurements.
Keep the complete glass/board/single-rod apparatus composition, transparent overlap and pane extension below the board. No isolated floating pane, omitted platform or extra rod.
